subject.title: [Security] Session hijacking vulnerability due to predictable sequence IDs in gateway client

question: Does the gateway security owner agree that event sequence numbers are non-secret ordering metadata and that this issue should close unless a PoC bypasses the authenticated connection and authorization path?
rationale: Current source does not support the claimed attack, but the protected security labels and gateway trust-boundary implications require explicit human security-owner disposition.

options.title: Close as unsupported
options.body: Confirm that sequence numbers are ordering metadata and close unless the reporter supplies a current-main PoC that crosses authentication or authorization.

options.title: Request a concrete PoC
options.body: Keep the report open temporarily and ask for an attacker model, exact frames, authentication state, and observed unauthorized effect on current main.

options.title: Open a private hardening review
options.body: Route any credible undisclosed transport or authentication evidence through the repository's private security process before considering code changes.

recommendation.title: Close as unsupported
recommendation.body: Confirm that sequence numbers are ordering metadata and close unless the reporter supplies a current-main PoC that crosses authentication or authorization.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS explicitly assigns the affected gateway security boundaries to this team.
